explanation.summary: CRITICAL: Severe thermal excursion exceeding facility baseline by 185% inside Jamnagar Mega Refinery.
evidence: Thermal Radiative Power (58.4 MW) exceeds facility maximum historical envelope (28.0 MW).
Located 0m inside primary crude distillation & hydrocracker polygon.
VIIRS Channel I4 brightness temperature reached 368.2 K (95.1°C).
Multi-pass thermal escalation detected across 2 orbital cycles.
explanation.recommendation: Deploy AR-AFFF foam monitors immediately. Establish 1,500m safety cordon. Notify NDRF 6th Bn & Gujarat SDMA.

explanation.summary: ELEVATED: Multi-pass persistent thermal signature detected at Hazira LNG & Chemical Terminal flare stack.
evidence: FRP 38.6 MW within elevated flare stack operating corridor.
Located inside ONGC / Shell Hazira industrial boundary polygon.
Thermal persistence recorded across 5 consecutive satellite passes.
Slight excursion (+38%) over mean baseline (15.2 MW).
explanation.recommendation: Monitor flare scrubbers. Maintain 800m perimeter safety buffer. Standby cooling water curtains.

explanation.summary: CRITICAL: Uncontained thermal breakout near crude storage tank farm at HPCL Visakhapatnam.
evidence: Thermal Radiative Power: 46.2 MW at 359.0 Kelvin (85.9°C).
Zero distance from coastal marine terminal fuel storage perimeter.
Sudden spike: baseline exceeded by 140% compared to 30-day mean.
Copernicus Sentinel-2 SWIR band confirms structural combustion.
explanation.recommendation: Trigger Level-3 Industrial Disaster Protocol. Dispatch coastal fire tenders with AR-AFFF foam. Evacuate 1,200m downwind.

explanation.summary: HIGH RISK: Anomalous thermal flare at IOCL Panipat Naphtha Cracker complex.
evidence: Thermal Radiative Power: 39.5 MW inside chemical processing unit.
Located directly within Panipat Refinery boundary polygon.
Brightness temperature elevated to 354.2 K (81.1°C).
NDMA chemical hazard flag: Naphtha / ethylene vapor risk.
explanation.recommendation: Isolate feed lines to naphtha cracking unit. Deploy dry chemical powder (Purple-K) and foam blankets.

explanation.summary: MONITORED: Urban refining complex flare stack baseline at BPCL/HPCL Mahul Trombay.
evidence: FRP 32.1 MW inside high-density Mumbai metropolitan buffer.
High consequence zone: 1.5 km to residential Mahul settlement.
Consistent multi-day flare observation pattern.
Within facility upper thermal envelope.
explanation.recommendation: Coordinate with MCGM Disaster Management Cell. Verify hydrocarbon vapor sensors at plant boundary.

explanation.summary: ROUTINE: High-intensity blast furnace & slag tapping thermal signature at Toranagallu.
evidence: FRP 48.0 MW consistent with heavy metallurgy steel manufacturing.
Continuous 7-day persistence at fixed blast furnace coordinates.
Normal thermal baseline for basic oxygen furnace operations.
explanation.recommendation: Catalog as routine metallurgical heat. No emergency dispatch required.

explanation.summary: ELEVATED: Coastal refinery flare operation at IOCL Paradip deepwater complex.
evidence: FRP 34.0 MW detected inside refinery boundary polygon.
Coastal wind dispersion active (18 km/h NE).
Continuous 3-pass satellite tracking.
explanation.recommendation: Monitor flare stack emission scrubbers. Standby port authority fireboats.

explanation.summary: ELEVATED: Petrochemical cluster flare at Dahej PCPIR Special Economic Zone.
evidence: Thermal flux 37.8 MW inside major chemical corridor.
Multiple hazardous chemical units in 2km radius.
Baseline stable but requires automated watch.
explanation.recommendation: Alert Dahej Industries Association fire station. Verify chlorine and benzene sensor telemetry.

explanation.recommendation: Routine metallurgic monitoring. No external response needed.
